_comment: Fields of the official specification whose name matches the secret pattern but which are not secret material, each with the reason. Checked by scripts/build/check-secrets.py. Anything genuinely secret belongs in a descriptor's secretFields instead.
AccessTokenInterval: Lifetime in seconds, not a token.
RefreshTokenInterval: Lifetime in seconds, not a token.
ClientSecretInterval: Rotation interval in seconds, not a secret.
JWTAccessTokenTimeout: Timeout in seconds on a web application.
JWTRefreshTokenTimeout: Timeout in seconds on a web application.
AccessTokenIsJWT: Boolean flag describing the token format.
ReturnRefreshToken: Boolean flag: whether the server returns one.
CSRFToken: Boolean flag on a web application: whether CSRF tokens are required.
ChangePassword: Boolean flag on a user account: must change at next login.
PasswordNeverExpires: Boolean flag on a user account.
ChangePasswordPage: URL of the page that changes a password.
ClientCredentials: Alias of an %SYS.X509Credentials object, as the official description states: a name, never the key.
ServerCredentials: Alias of an %SYS.X509Credentials object: a name, never the key.
Type: On WalletSecret, the secret's implementation class name (%Wallet.KeyValue and others); the value itself is WalletSecretConfig, which is declared secret.
token_endpoint: OAuth 2.0 server metadata: an endpoint URL.
token_endpoint_auth_method: OAuth 2.0 client metadata: the name of an authentication method.
token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported: OAuth 2.0 server metadata: names of supported methods.
token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg: OAuth 2.0 client metadata: an algorithm name.
access_token: Belongs to the official API's own /login and /refresh endpoints. FlightDeck authenticates through the IRIS session and never calls them, so no descriptor sends or reads this field (Constitution II).
refresh_token: Belongs to the official API's own /login and /refresh endpoints, which FlightDeck never calls.
password: Lower-case field of the official /login endpoint, which FlightDeck never calls: sign-in goes to IRIS itself (Constitution II).
AdminName: Encryption key file administrator name, on an operation declared unavailable by policy (spec FR-020): FlightDeck never sends it.
AdminPassword: Encryption key file password, on operations declared unavailable by policy (spec FR-020): FlightDeck never sends it, and the native path performs them.
NewAdminPassword: Encryption key file password, on an operation declared unavailable by policy (spec FR-020).
OldAdminPassword: Encryption key file password, on an operation declared unavailable by policy (spec FR-020).
